days.description: Replay recorded ticket activity from the last 7 (default) or 30 days.

intake.description: A sample new email to route.

rules.description: Proposed rules to check. Omit to check the saved rules. The rules document: { version: 1, intake: [...], activity: [...] }. Intake rules { id, description, enabled?, route: "file", emailType, match: { senderDomains?, senderAddresses?, onlyMessage?, automatic?, vendor?, subject?, subjectNot?, body?, bodyNot? } } file a new email without a ticket; route: "join_ticket" (no emailType) adds a vendor email about one order number to the open ticket that already holds that number, and opens a ticket otherwise. Activity rules { id, description, enabled?, route: "ignore", match: { sources, orderStatuses?, eventKinds?, eventSummary?, handledBy? } } skip the agent when every new ticket item matches. automatic: true matches mail a machine wrote; vendor: true matches mail from one of the company's pharmacies or clinical partners. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.
